an4.124:1.3: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.124:1.4: So yad eva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.
an4.124:1.5: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.124:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave idh' ekacco puggalo vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā . . . pe . . . dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . tatiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . . catutthajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an4.124:2.2: So yad eva tattha hoti rūpagatam . . . pe . . . te dhamme aniccato . . . anattato samanupassati.
an4.124:2.3: So kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Suddhāvāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjati.
an4.124:2.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 125. 1.
